script_text: Taurus, your wallet and heart are about to clash in the most profitable way imaginable. Your Earth sign practicality meets cosmic fire, demanding you take bold action on commitments you've been delaying. Trust the timing—opportunities are aligning for those ready to step forward. Your instincts are spot-on this week.
